notes.title: CyberCook 2.0 is Here – Bigger, Sharper, and Deadlier!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321714/12294a4e4969e10ad0ae497d80487f04b33a0c65.jpg[/img]

Step into the next era of CyberCook with our biggest update yet! We’ve been slicing away behind the scenes to bring you a fresh, enhanced, and even more sinister experience.

[b]Here’s what’s cooking in Version 2.0:[/b]

🔪 New Knives, New Freedom – Precision and power are in your hands. Slice, dice, and carve with an expanded arsenal of blades designed for maximum efficiency... and carnage.

🎵 A Soundtrack to Die For – We've collaborated with incredibly talented composers to bring new, immersive tracks that pull you even deeper into the neon-drenched nightmare of CyberCook.

🌍 A New Map – Welcome to the Rebel Sector – You’ve heard whispers about the rebels. Now, it’s time to visit… and decide whether they’ll remain standing or end up on the menu.

🖥 UI Enhancements – Smoother navigation, improved visuals, and a cleaner interface to make your experience even better.

🐞 Bug Fixes & Polish – A sharper, more refined CyberCook with fixes that enhance gameplay and stability.

🍽 New Meals & Ingredients – Fresh (or not-so-fresh) supplies have arrived, giving you even more creative ways to craft your unique dishes.

🌎 Russian & Turkish Localization – The world of CyberCook is now accessible to even more chefs.

Update 2.0 is now live! Fire up your knives, turn up the music, and step back into the kitchen where the only rule is survival. Let us know what you think, bon appétit.

notes.title: 500 Wishlists Reached – CyberCook 2.0 is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321714/13d4fc5b8cb5fda9de4f614397901e7fbe23bbda.png[/img]
We're beyond excited to announce that CyberCook has hit 500 wishlists! Your support means everything to us, and to celebrate, we’ve decided to go all in Version 2.0 is on the way!

That means more [b]blood[/b], more [b]meals[/b], and more [b]mysteries [/b] to uncover. 🩸🍽️🔎

You’ll hear more details when the update drops, but for now, just know this is our way of saying thank you. Your support keeps us going, and we can’t wait to share what’s next.

[i]Stay tuned and see you in Carcosa![/i]
[i]Vesvese Studios[/i]

notes.title: CyberCook is Now Live – Thank You for Your Support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45321714/cab228b2de2fe15f203cc193b7729fed685e5963.png[/img]
Thank you so much for your support throughout the development of CyberCook! The past few months have been a wild ride, full of challenges and hard work, but today, we’re beyond excited to finally share the game with you.

We truly hope you enjoy it! Whether you love it or have feedback, please consider leaving a review—it means the world to us and helps us grow. Your thoughts will shape our future projects, and we’re already deep into our next game, a [i]Dark Fantasy Vampire[/i] experience.

If you’d like to stay connected and get updates on what’s next, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7zTzmSmDx7]Discord[/url]!

See you in Carcosa,
Vesvese Studios
